church_two_agent_blind.goal: IMPORTANT: There is no blueprint available to you - the blueprint commands are blocked and no one can show you a blueprint. The level-and-coordinates list appended below is ONLY your build site location, not a design. Do not wait for a blueprint and do not ask for one. Design and build a church together at the cleared site where you spawn. Technical brief: footprint about 10 blocks wide by 12 long, 15 levels tall. Between you there are 153 oak_planks, 142 stone_bricks, 16 oak_stairs, 15 glass_pane, 4 torch, 4 oak_fence, 2 oak_door and 1 quartz_block. Requirements: oak plank floor, stone brick walls with glass pane windows, a front entrance with the oak doors, oak stair roofing, torches for interior light, plus fence detailing and a quartz centerpiece. There is no blueprint to follow - agree on the design yourselves from the brief above, divide the work, and share materials with !givePlayer.
